files.description: Fix TypeScript type error at the sort comparator by typing 'sort' as a key of the item shape (e.g. `keyof typeof item` or an explicit union type like 'name' | 'price' | 'quantity' | 'category' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt') and casting/validating the incoming sort parameter against that union before using it to index items in a[sort]/b[sort], so both the if-branch and else-branch comparator lines type-check cleanly.
